name: V5 POPULATE_FRAME gold corpus

documents.provenance: AUTHORED BY HAND for this repository. Invented content; no real organisation or process. Written so that its clauses fall into several different RAF slot groups, which is what makes the six-pass partition measurable per pass rather than in aggregate. Expected propositions in gold.json were chosen and reviewed by a human, not generated.

notes: SYNTHETIC (F1, unchanged in V5). Expected propositions are explicitly labelled in gold.json, each with the RAF slot a human assigned it and the verbatim evidence a human says supports it. Ground truth is human-authored; no AI output was used as ground truth. Weighted 0.25 by TIER_WEIGHT and never usable for a routing decision (ADR-0031 rule 4). NO REAL-WORLD MODEL QUALITY CLAIM MAY BE MADE FROM THIS TIER — and in V5 that warning is stronger than it was in V4b, because the thing V5 cannot verify (whether a proposition faithfully represents its evidence) is not measured here at all.
